title: samere me ghul hai bapa haaye haaye
body:
samere me ghul hai bapa haaye haaye
hoti hai bekas pe jafa haaye haaye
ghar se talab kar ke naqi aapko
zulm se bejaan kiya haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
khote hai jaa'n baap ke gham me yateem
ranj hai bachhou nko bada haaaye haaye
lut gaya ghar margaya waris mera
hai yehi bewa ki buka haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ummate jad ke liye daswe imam
seh gaye kya zulmo jafa haaye haaye
gham me pidar ke hassane askari
karte hai faryad o buka haaye haaye
